name: itecs-halopsa
description: Cross-platform HaloPSA MCP connector for ITECS reads and guarded ticket/project writes.

interface.longDescription: Provides HaloPSA lookups plus approval-gated private/public notes, private time entries, and typed ticket/project create and update tools. Ticket and project creation require explicit category, impact, and urgency values. Per-technician 1Password setup supports macOS and Windows. Email, replies, deletion, and raw passthrough are excluded.
defaultPrompt: List HaloPSA purchase orders that need CFO review.
Look up a HaloPSA client, invoice, contract, PO, ticket, or project.
Add an approved client-visible note to an exact HaloPSA ticket.
Create an approved HaloPSA ticket after previewing every field.
Move an exact HaloPSA ticket to an approved status after revalidation.
Add a private note or time entry to an exact HaloPSA ticket.
Create or update an approved HaloPSA project.
